book.name: TAITUS
book.title: TAITUS Pol so mamey Taitus se ma mey kow ha hok non

content: Hunkwe kristen Krit ko me senkin kwa me-kow, homkwe peyrmawk liarok uwr o, gavman o, hmo ouon mon-aw ka lwak, seyr hmo ok me-aw lonuayk me nok, nak-pyay. Seyr enekwei enekwei mokwe mey yaprue me meio e kwa naruok koruay.
Seyr uwrsa har me peie me-piapmapiap o, seyr homkwe liwak marowhway yor o, wayh-wayh me nan yor o, kwa mesair kow. Seyr homkwe uwrsa lowpwarowp mo inour mon kokwe uwr uru lopa se hieyn kwa lanio.

Payhokuaw, paraw kokwe hrom seyn, mo lowk la-pa-la, seyr lonuayk sisape, seyr hreme kokwe po me-loior kow, seyr lira-way yor piap o, omeme senkin senkin hromo uron me kar mon-ey ey o, hromkwe sohom mo mey-uwr puraw lwak wayr. Hromkwe uwrsa har me po lono-way, seyr uwrsa har mo mey yaprue me po lira-way, seyr har homkwe hreme awnie awnie-aw po lira, seyr hromkwe har me awnie-awnie-aw po lira.
Sawk hromo Huonok-prosue-uwr, God so nan-ihey yor o, hyo uron-pi ko-ar lwak yor o, sohom lousne hrahra ha menkin,

hiy sa hreme seme me-huonok prosue. Hiykwe hrom mey luw-luw-aw ma meio me hokuaw huonok prosue pa, sawk hyo uron lowk yor arian so hokuaw. Hiykwe hyo me-huonok prosue mey kokwe, Niohney Pekney-weys so kueir nonaw meio. Hiy hreme ma hawr kow hokwe, hreme ney iwon me hieyn po mon ousne, seyr su lwayr yor iwon se po kow.

Jisas Krais, hromo Huonok-prosue-uwr so mey ke hokuaw kokwe, God hiykwe hyo Niohney Pekney-weys se hromo lowpwarowp me kraiar kraiar sehe swanonyay kow, God so maym kow yor se hokuaw hreme luw-luw-aw ok me e. Sa hremekwe hyo uwrsa arian lwak e seme me-iaup, kyai lwayr peyow peyow ey hrom uron hyohyo ma lon ke lonok e.

Ok yaprue, ha ma mey okukwe, okar-ar. Hano uron hokwe senkin, hunkwe ok, ha ma mesor seme sehe hiy-mesor kraipakrai e, sa uwrsa, God se ma nan kiykiy-ay homkwe yor yaprue me-aw ka mon, yor, ayay ma leip sawan, seyr uwrsa lowpwarowp me ma hiymon seme.

Sawk hunkwe lon-seyrpaseyr yor senkin senkin o, nopwey-om mo uru sa-u mesor meiamei yor o, Moses so sow o, seme peie non-ondiay ondiay on-seyrpaseyr ohruw-a o. Payhokuaw, yor somokwe ayay liy leip ley, hme puraw mon nokriy nokriy yay.

Hunkwe uwr, ma lon seyrpaseyr senkin se kokwe peyr enekwei kamon kwa me-kupaku. Hiykwe lonuayk me pa lwak ankin, sei, enekwei kamon kwa ma-me. Hiykwe ma-lonuayk-me pa lwak ankin, hunkwe hye peie ma-londiay ondiay ohruw-a o.
Hunkwe senkin nonkway e, uwr senkin ma lon so uron hokwe weidnie-araw, seyr weynpaweyn piap-araw-ar non. Hyo weynpaweyn piap-araw somokwe hye nian senkin mesair kow, hiykwe heyn non.

Ara, enekwei ha Artemas o, Tikikus o, hoho prueyn se hno owh mon me-ha ankin, hunkwe sa hano owh mon kwa lok-nonanon e, om Nikopolis mon. Payhokuaw, hakwe po lonsan kawk, hakwe weyp-nono enekwei hokwe serey lwayr ley.
Hunkwe Rom mo sow ke hiymon-sorasor uwr Senas o, Apolos o, hehe kwa hiy-nuw-mon popriy ha, hoho yerki se. Hohkwe omeme ohna lwak lopa ka lwak.
Hromo uwrsa homkwe enekwei enekwei mey yaprue me-aw kwa meio, hom homkiaw-ayay-aw hiymon ey mokwe. Sawk hom ki mon ma kiy-wayr omokwe, akiaup liy lwak ley.

Uwrsa lowpwarowp hane nion ma non-wak homkwe hne me-ihey ha. Hunkwe seyr hromo me-ihey-ok ke God se nan kiykiy-ay uwrsa, hreme uron-pi ko-ar ma lwak me kwa ma-sahre kow. God so maym kow yor hokwe hme lowpwarowp me nion ka non-wak.
